title: Server: remove the 'outside' transfer state (owner: 'that is just a transaction'): Categorize must offer those rows, shared categoryNeed must not return transfer_outside, matcher stops producing it
description: From review-p8td.md follow-up 1 (on budget-p8td). The client no longer reads the 'outside' mark and shows such rows as needing a category, but the server still excludes them from the Categorize queue (api/src/categorize/store.ts:355) and shared/src/domain/category-needs.ts still returns transfer_outside; the matcher's waiting → outside policy and the marks endpoint still accept it. Remove the state end to end without changing balances: existing 'outside' marks are ignored (kept in the table), rows are ordinary uncategorized rows everywhere. Also decide what the 'waiting' state of old per-payee transfer rules becomes once those rules are converted.
